
<!--
Reproduces main Figure 3 (final version): CRR-target-gene vs control enrichment dotplots by genomic annotation, gene-fate proportions and target-gene TPM panels. Inputs (examples): output/roi_proximal.tg.v2.targets.tsv, output/clusters/controls/*, output/WebGestaltR/*. Outputs: outplots/fig3*.pdf.
--> 
fig3.plots

# =====================================================
## fig3_a 与control相比，在靶基因对应各区域的富集水平
```{r}

roi_proximal.tg <- read.table(file = "output/roi_proximal.tg.v2.targets.tsv",header= T,sep = "\t")


loc.annot.class <- c("promoter","exon","intron","distal_regulatory")
all.loc.annot.df <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:7){
    input <- roi_info.split[roi_info.split$cluster == i,]
    #input$name <- paste0(input$chr,":",input$start,":",input$end)
    input.tg <- roi_proximal.tg[roi_proximal.tg$name %in% input$peak,]
    input.bg.tg <- read.table(file = paste0("output/clusters/controls/cluster",i,".bg.tg.targets.tsv"),header = T,sep = "\t")
    output <- data.frame()
    for (j in 1:length(loc.annot.class)){
        a1=input.tg[input.tg$final_type == loc.annot.class[j],] %>% nrow()
        a2=nrow(input.tg) - a1
        b1=input.bg.tg[input.bg.tg$final_type == loc.annot.class[j],] %>% nrow()
        b2=nrow(input.bg.tg) - b1
        result <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a1,a2,b1,b2),nrow=2,ncol=2))
        out <- data.frame(cluster = paste0('cluster',i),annot = loc.annot.class[j],OR = result$estimate,upper = result$conf.int[2],lower = result$conf.int[1],pval=result$p.value)
        output <-rbind(output,out)
    }
    all.loc.annot.df <- rbind(all.loc.annot.df, output)

}


# 加载必要的库
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. 准备数据 (假设你的 dataframe 叫 all.loc.annot.df)
# 为了演示，如果数据还没转换成数值型，先确保转换
df <- all.loc.annot.df
df$pval <- ifelse(df$pval < 2.2e-16,2.2e-16,df$pval)

# 转换 OR 为 Beta (log e)
df$beta <- log(df$OR)

# 处理显著性大小：
# 设定阈值（例如 p < 0.05）。
# 如果不显著，设为一个固定小值；如果显著，根据 -log10(p) 映射到一个较大的范围。
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    is_sig = ifelse(pval < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant"),
    log_p = -log10(pval),
    # 创建一个用于绘图的大小变量：
    # 不显著的点统一给一个很小的值（例如 1），显著的点从 4 开始往上加
    plot_size = ifelse(pval >= 0.05, 1, 4 + (log_p / max(log_p) * 6))
  )

df <- df[df$annot != "intergenic_far",]
# 2. 因子排序（保持逻辑顺序）
df$cluster <- factor(df$cluster, levels = rev(unique(df$cluster)))
df$annot <- factor(df$annot, levels = c("promoter", "exon", "intron", "distal_regulatory"))

# 3. 绘图
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = annot, y = cluster)) +
  # 绘制背景网格线（可选，增加引导感）
  geom_point(aes(size = plot_size, color = beta)) +
  
  # 颜色设置：使用 gradient2 并在 0 附近设置极窄的过渡
  # 这样哪怕是 0.001 也会立刻带上颜色倾向
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#377EB8",      # 蓝色 (Diluted)
    mid = "white",        # 0 为白色
    high = "#E41A1C",     # 红色 (Enriched)
    midpoint = 0,
    name = expression(beta == log(OR)) # Legend 标题显示公式
  ) +
  
  # 大小设置：取消连续映射，直接使用计算好的 plot_size
  scale_size_identity(
    guide = "legend", 
    name = "Significance",
    breaks = c(1, 3, 5),
    labels = c("p >= 0.05", "p < 0.01", "p < 1e-10") # 这里的 label 需根据实际数据调整
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    x = "Target-relative position",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1 ,color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("outplots/fig3/fig3_a.loc.tg.annot.dotplot.pdf",p,width=6,height=8,dpi=300)


```


# =====================================================
## fig3_b 各cluster靶基因数量分布图
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

roi.proximal.tg <- roi_proximal.tg[,c(1,2,3,4,6,7,8)]
roi.proximal.tg$cluster <- roi_info.split[match(roi.proximal.tg$name,roi_info.split$peak),"cluster"]
colnames(roi.proximal.tg) <- c("chr","start","end","peak","id","type","distance","cluster")


library(tximport)
library(DESeq2)

period <- c("MSC","ADI-7d","ADI-14d")
sample_list <- c("MSC_rep1","MSC_rep2","MSC_rep3","ADI-7d_rep1","ADI-7d_rep2","ADI-7d_rep3","ADI-14d_rep1","ADI-14d_rep2","ADI-14d_rep3")

# 定义存在表达的基因
tg.keeped <- setdiff(ref$gene_id,rownames(all.tpm[all.tpm$MSC < 1 & all.tpm$ADI_7d < 1 & all.tpm$ADI_15d < 1,]))

files <- paste0('~/Project/19-NG/RNA-seq/out/',sample_list,'.genes.results')
txi <- tximport(files, type="rsem")

# 把非正长度处理掉（0/NA/负数）
txi$length[!is.finite(txi$length) | txi$length <= 0] <- 1
sampleTable <- data.frame(
  row.names = names(files),
  condition = c("MSC","MSC","MSC","ADI-7d","ADI-7d","ADI-7d","ADI-14d","ADI-14d","ADI-14d")
)
sampleTable$condition <- factor(sampleTable$condition)

log2FC_cutoff <- 0.5
padj_cutoff   <- 0.05

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, sampleTable, ~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
res <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition", "ADI-14d","MSC")) %>% as.data.frame %>% na.omit()

res1 <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition", "ADI-7d","MSC")) %>% as.data.frame %>% na.omit()
res2 <- results(dds,contrast = c("condition", "ADI-14d","ADI-7d")) %>% as.data.frame %>% na.omit()

res1 <- res1[rownames(res1) %in% tg.keeped,]
res1$change <- "N.S"
res1$change[res1$log2FoldChange >=  log2FC_cutoff & res1$padj < padj_cutoff] <- "Up"
res1$change[res1$log2FoldChange <= -log2FC_cutoff & res1$padj < padj_cutoff] <- "Down"

res2 <- res2[tg.keeped,]
res2$change <- "N.S"
res2$change[res2$log2FoldChange >=  log2FC_cutoff & res2$padj < padj_cutoff] <- "Up"
res2$change[res2$log2FoldChange <= -log2FC_cutoff & res2$padj < padj_cutoff] <- "Down"


all.clusters.tg.res.annot <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:7){
    input <- roi.proximal.tg[roi.proximal.tg$cluster == i,]
    input.res1 <- res1[rownames(res1) %in% input$id,]
    input.res2 <- res2[rownames(res2) %in% input$id,]
    out1 <- c(table(input.res1$change)[1],table(input.res1$change)[2],table(input.res1$change)[3],length(unique(input$id))-length(intersect(input$id,tg.keeped)))/length(unique(input$id))
    out2 <- c(table(input.res2$change)[1],table(input.res2$change)[2],table(input.res2$change)[3],length(unique(input$id))-length(intersect(input$id,tg.keeped)))/length(unique(input$id))
    output <- data.frame(
        cluster = paste0('cluster',i),
        category= c("d7-d0","d14-d7"),
        repressed = c(out1[1],out2[1]),
        unchanged = c(out1[2],out2[2]),
        induced = c(out1[3],out2[3]),
        silent = c(out1[4],out2[4])
    )
    all.clusters.tg.res.annot <- rbind(all.clusters.tg.res.annot,output)
}


# 2. 数据清洗与因子排序
plot_data <- all.clusters.tg.res.annot %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(repressed, unchanged, induced, silent), 
               names_to = "fate", values_to = "proportion")

# 设定 Fate 的顺序 (从左到右：Induced -> Unchanged -> Repressed -> Silent)
plot_data$fate <- factor(plot_data$fate, 
                         levels = rev(c("induced", "repressed", "unchanged", "silent")))

# 设定 Cluster 顺序 (确保图中从上到下是 1-7)
plot_data$cluster <- factor(plot_data$cluster, 
                            levels = rev(paste0("cluster", 1:7)))

# 设定 Category 顺序
plot_data$category <- factor(plot_data$category, levels = c("d7-d0", "d14-d7"))
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
# 3. 绘图
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = cluster, y = proportion, fill = fate)) +
  # 绘制条形图，添加白色细边框增加精致感
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # 坐标轴翻转
  coord_flip() +
  # 分面：上下排列，不共享 Y 轴刻度（为了保持独立感）
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  # 配色方案
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "induced"   = "#E64B35FF", # 珊瑚红 (NPG)
    "unchanged" = "#F0F0F0",   # 极浅灰
    "repressed" = "#4DBBD5FF", # 灰蓝 (NPG)
    "silent"    = "#3C3C3CFF"  # 深炭灰
  )) +
  # 格式化 Y 轴为百分比
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  # 主题美化
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    # 移除背景网格
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # 分面标签美化
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    # 坐标轴文字
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    # 图例位置
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    # 增加面板之间的间距
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
  )

# 4. 输出
print(p)
ggsave("outplots/fig3/fig3_b.Gene_Fate_Proportion.pdf", p, width = 7, height = 8,dpi=300)

```


# =====================================================
## fig3_c 各cluster靶基因表达箱线图
```{r}
tg.keeped <- all.tpm[all.tpm$MSC >=1 | all.tpm$ADI_7d >=1 | all.tpm$ADI_15d >=1,] %>% row.names()
tg.keeped <- intersect(tg.keeped,ref$gene_id)

all.tpm.df <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:7){
    input <- roi.proximal.tg[roi.proximal.tg$cluster == i,"id"]
    input <- intersect(input,tg.keeped)
    out <- log2(all.tpm[input,]+1)
    output <- data.frame(
        cluster=rep(paste0('cluster',i),3*nrow(out)),
        category=c(rep('MSC',nrow(out)),rep('ADI-7d',nrow(out)),rep('ADI-15d',nrow(out))),
        tpm=c(out$MSC,out$ADI_7d,out$ADI_15d)
    )
    print(c(
        t.test(out$MSC,out$ADI_7d,paired = T)$p.value,
        t.test(out$MSC,out$ADI_15d,paired = T)$p.value,
        t.test(out$ADI_7d,out$ADI_15d,paired = T)$p.value
    ))
    all.tpm.df <- rbind(all.tpm.df,output)
}

data <- all.tpm.df
data$category <- factor(data$category,c("MSC","ADI-7d","ADI-15d"))
data$cluster <- factor(data$cluster,paste0('cluster',1:7))

data$row_group <- ifelse(data$cluster %in% c("cluster1", "cluster2", "cluster3", "cluster4"), "Group A", "Group B")

# 如果你的 cluster 是数字 1-7，则用：
# data$row_group <- ifelse(data$cluster <= 4, "Group A", "Group B")

# 2. 绘图
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = cluster, y = tpm, fill = category)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar",
               width=0.4,
               position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
               outlier.shape = NA) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4b92c3", "#56b356" , "#de5253")) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(data$tpm)+0.5, max(data$tpm))) +
  labs(y = "log(Target Gene TPM +1)", x = " ", fill = "Class") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  
  # --- 关键修改部分：分面 ---
  facet_wrap(~row_group, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") + 
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"),  
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),  
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),   
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
    
    # 隐藏分面标签的背景和文字（如果你不想看到 "Group A" "Group B" 的横条）
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank()
  )

# 保存图片（注意：分面后高度可能需要增加，建议 height 调大一点，比如 7 或 8）
ggsave(p, file = "outplots/fig3/fig3_d.all.clu.tg.tpm.pdf", width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```




# ============================================================
## fig3_e 上调和下调基因的GO富集情况
```{r}

## 提取关键通路画两个点图

all.up.dotplot.input <- read.table(file = "output/WebGestaltR/all.go.up.dotplot.input.txt",header = T,sep = "\t")

all.up.dotplot.input[,3:9] <- lapply(all.up.dotplot.input[,3:9], as.numeric)

all.up.dotplot.input[,3:9] <- lapply(all.up.dotplot.input[,3:9], function(x) {
  res <- x
  # 明确排除 NA，并满足 0 < x <= 1
  idx <- !is.na(x) & (x > 0) & (x <= 1)
  res[idx] <- -log10(x[idx])
  res[is.na(res)] <- 0
  res
})

all.up.dotplot.input$category <- factor(
  all.up.dotplot.input$category,
  levels = c("GO", "Pathway")
)

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)


## 1. 宽表转长表 ---------------------------------------------------------
df_long <- all.up.dotplot.input %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("cluster"),
    names_to = "cluster",
    values_to = "log10FDR"   # 你的数值列是 -log10(FDR)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster,
                     levels = paste0("cluster", 1:7),
                     labels = 1:7)
  )

## 2. 设定显著/不显著，并排序通路 --------------------------------------
sig_cutoff <- 1.3   # 例如 -log10(0.05)，可以按需要修改

df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(log10FDR >= sig_cutoff, "significant", "nonsig")
  ) %>%
  # 计算每个 term 在各自 category 内的最大显著性，用于排序
  group_by(name, category) %>%
  mutate(max_log10FDR = max(log10FDR, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(category, max_log10FDR) %>%
  mutate(name = fct_inorder(name))

## 3. 画 dotplot：所有格子都有点 ---------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(df_long,
            aes(x = cluster, y = name)) +
  # 先画背景：所有点（灰色，小）
  geom_point(
    data = ~ .x,               # 所有数据
    color = "grey85",
    size  = 1.5                 # 背景点大小固定
  ) +
  # 再画显著点：有颜色、随 log10FDR 变大
  geom_point(
    data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, sig == "significant"),
    aes(size = log10FDR, color = log10FDR)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name  = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
    range = c(3, 6)             # 显著点大小范围
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    name  = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
    low   = "#f5abb7",
    high  = "#cb364a"
  ) +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y     = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank(),
    legend.position="top",
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(0.6, "lines")
  ) +
  xlab("Cluster")


ggsave(p, file = "outplots/fig3/fig3_e.up.tg.GO.dotplots.pdf", width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

all.down.dotplot.input[,3:9] <- lapply(all.down.dotplot.input[,3:9], as.numeric)
```

# =====================================================
## sup3_b 各clusters与其靶基因的距离的山脊图
```{r}

clu.distance.list <- list()
for (i in 1:7){
    clu.tg <- roi_proximal.tg[roi_proximal.tg$name %in% roi_info.split[roi_info.split$cluster == i,"peak"],]
    clu.tg <- clu.tg[clu.tg$final_type != "intergenic_far",]
    hist(log10(clu.tg$final_distance+1))
    clu.distance.list[[i]] <- sqrt(clu.tg$final_distance)
}

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

## 1. 把 list 转成长表
plot.df <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(clu.distance.list), function(i){
    data.table(
```

## sup3_d 基因表达三时间三reps热图展示各cluster对应靶基因表达情况
```{r}

optimize_matrix_for_heatmap <- function(df, epsilon = NULL, dist_method = "euclidean", seriate_method = "OLO") {
  
  library(seriation)
  library(matrixStats)
  
  # 2. 转换为矩阵
  mat <- as.matrix(df)
  
  # 3. 计算 Soft-scaling
  # 计算每行的标准差
  row_sds <- rowSds(mat)
  
  # 如果没有指定 epsilon，则自动计算所有基因标准差的中位数作为平滑项
  if (is.null(epsilon)) {
    epsilon <- median(row_sds, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  # 执行 Soft-scaling: (x - mean) / (sd + epsilon)
  # 这能有效压制低表达基因在 scale 后的伪显著性
  mat_scaled <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (s == 0) return(x - m) # 处理零方差基因
    return((x - m) / (s + epsilon))
  }))
  
  # 保持原有的行列名称
  rownames(mat_scaled) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(mat_scaled) <- colnames(mat)
  
  # 4. 进行 OLO 聚类排序 (Optimal Leaf Ordering)
  message("正在进行 OLO 聚类排序，基因较多时请稍候...")
  
  # 计算行距离
  gene_dist <- dist(mat_scaled, method = dist_method)
  
  # 使用 seriation 包进行优化排序
  # OLO 算法会寻找一种叶节点排列方式，使得相邻行之间的相似度最大化
  row_seriate <- seriate(gene_dist, method = seriate_method)
  row_order <- get_order(row_seriate)
  
  # 5. 根据排序结果重排矩阵
  mat_final <- mat_scaled[row_order, ]
  
  message("处理完成。")
  return(mat_final)
}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(seriation)
library(patchwork) # 用于组合图片和控制比例
library(matrixStats)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 单个 ggplot 热图绘制函数
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_single_heatmap <- function(tidy_df, show_x_axis = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(tidy_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Gene, fill = Zscore)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "firebrick3", 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2, 2), oob = scales::squish) +
    facet_grid(Group ~ .) + # 使用分面来显示组名
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(), # 基因通常很多，隐藏行名
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"), # 组名水平显示
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, r = 5, l = 5)
    )
  
  if (!show_x_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
                   axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
  
  return(p)
}

    input.scaled <- optimize_matrix_for_heatmap(input.df)
    df_tidy <- as.data.frame(input.scaled) %>%
        mutate(Gene = rownames(.)) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = -Gene, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Zscore")
  
  # 关键：将 Gene 设为 Factor，并指定 Level 为 OLO 排序后的顺序
  # 将 Sample 也设为 Factor 保持原始列顺序
  df_tidy$Gene <- factor(df_tidy$Gene, levels = rev(rownames(input.scaled))) # rev 是因为 ggplot 坐标轴从下往上画
  df_tidy$Sample <- factor(df_tidy$Sample, levels = colnames(input.scaled))
  df_tidy$Group <- paste0('cluster',i)
    df_list[[i]] <- df_tidy
}

for (i in 1:length(df_list)) {
```

## sup3_g. 多变量线性回归图，尤其是展示clu567的线性回归情况，因为在clu567的靶基因是存在显著上调的。
```{r}
period <- c("d0","d7","d15")
period_delta <- c("d0_d7","d7_d15","d0_d15")
chip <- c("DNase","H3K27ac","H3K27me3","H3K36me3","H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K9ac","H3K9me3")


Create_period_df <- function(input.feats.df,input.proximal.tg.df,period_temp){ # 此函数用于计算单一时间对应的特征矩阵
    chip <- c("DNase","H3K27ac","H3K27me3","H3K36me3","H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K9ac","H3K9me3")
    input.tg <- unique(input.proximal.tg.df$id)
    output <- data.frame()
    for (j in 1:length(input.tg)){
        tg.tpm <- log2(all.tpm[input.tg[j],which(period == period_temp)]+1)
        peaks <- input.proximal.tg.df[input.proximal.tg.df$id == input.tg[j],"peak"]
        df <- input.feats.df[peaks,]
        out_feats <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(df),ncol=length(chip)))
        colnames(out_feats) <- chip
        for (k in 1:length(chip)){
            out_feats[,k] <- df[,paste0(chip[k],'_',period_temp,'_coverage')]
        }
        out <- cbind(data.frame(gene_id=input.tg[j],tpm=tg.tpm),out_feats)
        output <- rbind(output,out)
    }
    return(output)

}


Create_delta_df <- function(input.feats.df,input.proximal.tg.df,delta_class){ # 此函数用于计算两时间作差值的特征矩阵
    chip <- c("DNase","H3K27ac","H3K27me3","H3K36me3","H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K9ac","H3K9me3")
    input.tg <- unique(input.proximal.tg.df$id)
    period1 <- unlist(strsplit(delta_class,"_"))[1]
    period2 <- unlist(strsplit(delta_class,"_"))[2]
    output <- data.frame()
    for (j in 1:length(input.tg)){
        tg.tpm.delta <- log2(all.tpm[input.tg[j],which(period == period2)]+1)-log2(all.tpm[input.tg[j],which(period == period1)]+1)
        peaks <- input.proximal.tg.df[input.proximal.tg.df$id == input.tg[j],"peak"]
        df <- input.feats.df[peaks,]
        out_feats <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(df),ncol=length(chip)))
        colnames(out_feats) <- chip
        for (k in 1:length(chip)){
            out_feats[,k] <- df[,paste0(chip[k],'_',period2,'_coverage')]-df[,paste0(chip[k],'_',period1,'_coverage')]
        }
        out <- cbind(data.frame(gene_id=input.tg[j],tpm=tg.tpm.delta),out_feats)
        output <- rbind(output,out)
    }
    return(output)

}

all.output.period <- data.frame()
all.delta.period <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:7){
    input <- roi_info.split[roi_info.split$cluster == i,]
    input.feats.df <- feats_coverage[roi_info.split$cluster == i,]
    input.proximal.tg.df <- roi.proximal.tg[roi.proximal.tg$cluster == i & roi.proximal.tg$id %in% tg.keeped,]
    output1 <- data.frame()
    output2 <- data.frame()
    for (j in 1:3){
        out.period.df <- Create_period_df(input.feats.df,input.proximal.tg.df,period[j])
        out.delta.df <- Create_delta_df(input.feats.df,input.proximal.tg.df,period_delta[j])
        ## 计算每个chip的1分布，如果含量非常低（小于0.05）则判定这个chip不具备解释能力应该被踢出去。
        ratio1 <- sapply(out.period.df[,-c(1,2)], function(x) mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
        ratio2 <- sapply(out.delta.df[,-c(1,2)], function(x) mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
        out.period.df[,colnames(out.period.df) %in% names(ratio1[ratio1 >= 0.95])] <- 0
        out.delta.df[,colnames(out.delta.df) %in% names(ratio2[ratio2 >= 0.95])] <- 0
        model1 <- lm(tpm ~ DNase + H3K27ac + H3K27me3 + H3K36me3 + 
                H3K4me1 + H3K4me3 + H3K9ac + H3K9me3, 
                data = out.period.df)
        model2 <- lm(tpm ~ DNase + H3K27ac + H3K27me3 + H3K36me3 + 
                H3K4me1 + H3K4me3 + H3K9ac + H3K9me3, 
                data = out.delta.df)
        coef_matrix1 <- as.data.frame(summary(model1)$coefficients)[-1,]
        #coef_matrix1[,4] <- p.adjust(coef_matrix1[,4])
        output1 <- rbind(output1,data.frame(cluster=paste0('cluster',i),period=period[j],chip=chip,estimate=coef_matrix1[match(chip,rownames(coef_matrix1)),1],pval=coef_matrix1[match(chip,rownames(coef_matrix1)),4]))

        coef_matrix2 <- as.data.frame(summary(model2)$coefficients)[-1,]
        #coef_matrix2[,4] <- p.adjust(coef_matrix2[,4])
        output2 <- rbind(output2,data.frame(cluster=paste0('cluster',i),period=period_delta[j],chip=chip,estimate=coef_matrix2[match(chip,rownames(coef_matrix2)),1],pval=coef_matrix2[match(chip,rownames(coef_matrix2)),4]))
     
    }
    all.output.period <- rbind(all.output.period,output1)
    all.delta.period <- rbind(all.delta.period,output2)
}

  )

print(p)
ggsave("outplots/fig3/sup3_g.all.period.lm.heatmap.pdf",p,width=8,height=8,dpi=300)


df_long <- all.delta.period
df_long$estimate[df_long$estimate >=5] <- 4.99
df_long$period <- factor(df_long$period,c("d0_d7","d7_d15","d0_d15"))
df_long$cluster <- factor(df_long$cluster,c("Total",paste0('cluster',7:1)))
# 增加一列用于显示星号：如果 > 1.301 则为 "*", 否则为空 ""
df_long$sig_label <- ifelse(df_long$log10FDR > 1.301, "*", "")

# 绘图：ggplot2 分面热图
library(scales)
p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = period, y = cluster, fill = estimate)) +
  # 1. 画热图方块
  geom_tile(color = "white") + 
  
  # 2. 添加显著性星号层
  # vjust 控制星号在方块内的垂直位置，color 设为黑色或深灰
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), 
            color = "black", 
            size = 6, 
            vjust = 0.7) + 
  
  # 3. 核心修改：处理不对称的颜色范围
  # 使用 gradientn 自定义颜色梯度，确保 0 处为白色
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#762a83", "white", "#1b7837"), # 对应 RdBu 的深蓝、白、深红
    values = rescale(c(-1, 0, 3)),            # 关键：将 -3, 0, 5 映射到 0, 0.5, 1 的比例空间
    limits = c(-1, 3),                        # 设置总范围
    name = "Estimate",
    oob = squish                              # 如果有超出 -3 或 5 的值，将其压缩到边界颜色
  ) +
  
  # 4. 分面与其他样式
  facet_wrap(~chip, nrow = 2) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(title = "ChIP Enrichment Impact on Gene Expression",
       x = "Time Point",
       y = "",
       fill = "Estimate") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    # 如果背景色太深，星号可能看不清，可以根据需要调整
    panel.grid = element_blank() 
  )

print(p)
ggsave("outplots/fig3/sup3_g.all.delta.lm.heatmap.pdf",p,width=8,height=8,dpi=300)
```
